[[Levincia]]
[[Schedar Squad's Base]] }} (Japanese: '''強奪！狙いはミライドン！！''' ''Robbery! The Aim is Miraidon!!'') is the 14th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is subtitled (Japanese: '''VS エクスレッグ''' ''VS {{tt|Exleg|Lokix}}''). ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Violet}} makes his way to the [[Schedar Squad's Base]], but finds himself repeatedly ambushed by {{tc|Team Star Grunt}}s. His {{p|Nymble}}, after fighting in yet another battle against them, [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{p|Lokix}}. When Violet wonders aloud if the ambushes will continue, [[Cassiopeia]] hijacks [[Old Roto]] to inform him that [[Team Star]] has been sharing a wanted poster of Violet amongst themselves. This leads Violet to come up with an idea and whisper it to Cassiopeia. He then takes off on {{ga|Miraidon}}, heading to [[Levincia]]. While in Levincia, Violet purchases several [[sandwich]]es to share with Miraidon. As Miraidon eats them, it begins to think of {{adv|Arven}} and daydreams about the sandwiches he makes. It turns around and begins wandering off, confusing Violet. Meanwhile, as the grunts at the Schedar Squad's Base celebrate that Violet had turned away, {{adv|Scarlet}} arrives. She meets with the squad boss, [[Mela]], who attempts to have a friendly conversation with her. Instead, Scarlet confronts Mela about the forceful behavior of the grunts. She explains that while they first were kind to girls with nowhere to go, they devolved into harassing people into joining them. Angered, Mela demands her to help protect their base as payment for rescuing her in the past, but Scarlet points out that back then, Mela had only requested her to help out any others in need. Scarlet then asks Mela where the {{p|Charcadet}} in the base have gone, pointing out there used to be several that followed her around, including one named Charlos. This infuriates Mela, who demands her to leave. As Scarlet makes her way out of the base, she overhears some grunts speaking of Violet. She goes to investigate, soon finding a disguised Violet approaching the base. She blocks his way, calling him by his full name, which the grunts witness. As they rush away to report this to Mela, Violet worries aloud what he and "Letty" should do next. When Scarlet is surprised he would call her that, Violet tells her he had recognized her from both the [[PASV01|demonstration battle]] and [[Iono]]'s [[PASV12|livestream]]. Realizing Violet is smarter than she initially thought, she tells him she would like to borrow Iron Serpent. Confused, Violet lets Miraidon out of its [[Poké Ball]], leading Scarlet to climb onto its back. He tries to dissuade her from riding it without permission, but she has her {{p|Tarountula}} wrap him up in its webbing. When Scarlet tells him she will return Miraidon after obtaining the [[treasures of ruin]], it then darts off in search of Arven's sandwiches. As Miraidon speeds away, it passes [[Clavell]], riding his {{p|Cyclizar}} while dressed in his Clive attire. He soon finds Violet on the ground, then sends out his {{p|Houndoom}} to free him. After Violet updates him on the situation, {{adv|Nemona}} suddenly approaches the two, asking if they have seen Scarlet. In the [[Asado Desert]], Arven waits for {{DL|Titan Pokémon|the Quaking Earth Titan}} to appear. Hearing Miraidon's [[cry]], Arven begins to ask if Violet is finished with the raid, but is shocked to find Scarlet on its back instead. ==Major events== * {{Violet}} begins his assault on the [[Schedar Squad's Base]]. * Violet's {{p|Nymble}} evolves into {{p|Lokix}}. * {{Scarlet}} meets with [[Mela]] and turns down her request to defend the base. * Violet and Scarlet meet, with Scarlet stealing {{ga|Miraidon}} from him. * Violet encounters {{adv|Nemona}}, while Scarlet encounters {{adv|Arven}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Bramblin}} * {{p|Rellor}} * {{p|Lokix}} * {{p|Revavroom}} ({{form|Revavroom|Schedar Starmobile}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Violet}} * {{Scarlet}} * {{adv|Nemona}} * {{adv|Arven}} * [[Mela]] * [[Clive]] * {{tc|Team Star Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Miraidon}} ({{OP|Violet|Miraidon}}) * {{p|Crocalor}} ({{Violet}}'s) * {{p|Nymble}} ({{Violet}}'s;
